warmup.description: Ease into movement with breath-led mobility and gentle lateral activation.
movements: Side-lying rib breathing x 5 breaths per side
Thread the needle x 6 per side
Hip circles in tabletop x 8 per direction

main_exercises.name: Lateral core flow (side bend patterns)
main_exercises.form_cue: Lengthen through the side body as you move, avoiding collapsing into the shoulder.

main_exercises.name: Posterior chain and core integration (swimming prep and lifts)
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep neck long and lift limbs lightly while maintaining a stable torso.

main_exercises.name: Controlled leg lowering (supine)
main_exercises.form_cue: Lower legs slowly while keeping the pelvis stable and core engaged.

main_exercises.name: Quadruped balance and reach
main_exercises.form_cue: Reach long through opposite arm and leg without shifting hips or shoulders.

main_exercises.name: Gentle hollow body holds and transitions
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep lower back softly anchored and maintain steady breathing throughout.

cooldown.description: Promote relaxation and release through slow stretching and breath awareness.
movements: Seated side stretch x 60s per side
Supine figure-4 stretch x 60s per side
Full body stretch with deep breathing x 90s

phase_notes.menstrual: This session’s gentle lateral and posterior work is ideal—move slowly and keep range of motion comfortable, especially in leg lowering.
phase_notes.follicular: You may feel more coordinated—focus on refining balance and control in quadruped and hollow body work.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Take advantage of improved stability—slightly extend hold times or deepen control in lateral and balance movements.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Use this session to maintain consistency—keep movements smooth and avoid rushing through transitions.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Prioritize ease and fluidity—reduce intensity of holds if needed and focus on calming, rhythmic breathing.
